components.name: Guide Sign
components.description: Green field, white lettering, inset white line. Hero name and section titles.
components.css: .ds-sign { position: relative; border-radius: 10px; padding: 28px 36px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 40px; letter-spacing: 0.025em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; display: inline-block; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-sign::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 5px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 6px; opacity: 0.88; pointer-events: none; } .ds-sign:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 18px 28px -14px oklch(0.2 0.05 155 / 0.5); } .ds-guide { background: oklch(0.44 0.105 155); color: oklch(0.985 0.005 140); }

components.name: Caution Sign
components.description: Warning yellow with dark ink; status and highlights.
components.css: .ds-sign { position: relative; border-radius: 10px; padding: 28px 36px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 40px; line-height: 0.95; text-transform: uppercase; display: inline-block; } .ds-sign::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 7px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 6px; opacity: 0.85; pointer-events: none; } .ds-caution { background: oklch(0.87 0.17 92); color: oklch(0.2 0.02 90); }

components.name: Asphalt Sign
components.description: Near-black field with a yellow inset line.
components.css: .ds-sign { position: relative; border-radius: 10px; padding: 28px 36px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 40px; text-transform: uppercase; display: inline-block; } .ds-sign::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 7px; border: 2px solid oklch(0.87 0.17 92 / 0.7); border-radius: 6px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-asphalt { background: oklch(0.23 0.012 150); color: oklch(0.95 0.006 140); }

components.name: Info Sign
components.description: White panel, dark green lettering, green inset line; also hosts the contact form.
components.css: .ds-sign { position: relative; border-radius: 10px; padding: 28px 36px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 40px; text-transform: uppercase; display: inline-block; } .ds-sign::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 7px; border: 2px solid oklch(0.44 0.105 155); border-radius: 6px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-info { background: oklch(0.99 0.004 140); color: oklch(0.3 0.08 155); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Green condensed uppercase action; the one primary per view.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(0.44 0.105 155); color: oklch(0.985 0.005 140); font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover { background: oklch(0.44 0.105 155 / 0.8); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.21 0.012 150); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.78 0.012 145); border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(0.945 0.007 140); color: oklch(0.21 0.012 150); font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.91 0.01 140); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.21 0.012 150); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: White field on the info sign, in both themes.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 48px; width: 260px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.3 0.08 155 / 0.5); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: oklch(0.3 0.08 155); font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.3 0.08 155 / 0.6); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.44 0.105 155); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.44 0.105 155 / 0.4); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Condensed uppercase link with a growing underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.43 0.015 150); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav span { position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 2px; height: 3px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.44 0.105 155); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-nav:hover { color: oklch(0.21 0.012 150); } .ds-nav:hover span { transform: scaleX(1); }

components.name: Lane Line
components.description: Dashed yellow divider; the only divider in the system.
components.css: .ds-lane { width: 320px; height: 4px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.78 0.17 90) 0 26px, transparent 26px 46px); }

narrative.overview:
The page is a road and each section is a sign you pass. Philippine highway signage supplies the whole material vocabulary: guide-sign green with a white inset border line, warning yellow, asphalt black, white information panels, all set on concrete grey. Dark mode is the same signs at night: asphalt ground, with the green and yellow reading as reflective against it. The signs keep their identity in both themes; only the ground changes.

Density is generous and confident. Lettering is huge condensed caps on flat colour fields; body text stays in a calm humanist sans. Layout rhythm comes from unequal sign spans (4+2 / 2+4), not equal cards. The dashed lane line is the only divider.
keyCharacteristics: Flat coloured fields with a 2px inset border line (the sign), one 10px corner radius.
Condensed uppercase sign lettering at 700-800 weight; Barlow for reading text.
Four sign classes, selected by tone: guide, caution, asphalt, info.
Dashed yellow lane line as the sole divider; a scroll-driven road marker on wide screens.
Reflective sheen and a small lift on interactive signs, pointer devices only.

rules.name: The Four Signs Rule
rules.body: Colour lives on signs. A surface is one of guide, caution, asphalt or info (via data-tone); never invent a fifth sign colour or tint a sign gradient.

rules.name: The Same Signs At Night Rule
rules.body: Dark mode changes the ground, not the signs. Sign identity must read in both themes.

rules.name: The Lettering Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps are for signs: names, section titles, project titles, nav, buttons. Reading text never uses the condensed face.

rules.name: The Flat Sign Rule
rules.body: Signs are flat at rest. Lift appears only in response to hover; never as a resting shadow.

dos: Do express every new surface as one of the four signs, using data-tone and the .sign class.
Do keep a single 10px radius; tags at 4px.
Do use the dashed lane as the only divider.
Do keep focus visible: a 3px outline in --ring with 3px offset (near-black by day, yellow at night).
Do keep contrast on sign fields by using the paired foreground token for each tone.
donts: Don't introduce a fifth colour field, gradients on sign faces, or glow effects in dark mode.
Don't use equal-width card grids for work; vary spans.
Don't put condensed caps on running text.
Don't add resting shadows or borders-as-dividers between sections.
Don't let hover lift or the light streak run on touch devices.
